title: Borneo Dreams
notes: Sabah ambient journey · ~8 hours. Authoritative pool: 91 Borneo images × 4 curated passes. Soundtrack alternates audio/borneo_dreams_with_rain.mp3 ↔ audio/borneo_dreams_with_rain_2.mp3 (8 plays, 29070.728s total). Opening title once on first landscape. Four language verses distributed across passes. Final sunset only: Malaysia → 馬来西亜 (charcoal). Music ends with fade to black; gold 漢 crest silent after. No Jungle Spirit kanji overlays.
